title: Uruguayan Burrata Salad
description: A light and refreshing salad featuring burrata cheese, mixed greens, and a wine-infused dressing, with anti-inflammatory properties from turmeric and ginger
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to roast the beets for the salad.
Steam the mixed greens with turmeric and ginger for 5 minutes to enhance their flavor and nutritional value.
Whisk together the white wine vinegar, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to create the dressing.
Cut the burrata cheese into small pieces and place them on top of the steamed mixed greens.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Garnish with roasted beets and serve immediately.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, let the salad come to room temperature for the best flavor and texture.
